input_messages.content: Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation. I want to move my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight on the next day, and also shift my return flight from SFO back by one day. Can you help me with that?
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

Yes, that’s correct—I want to move my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight on the next day, and shift my return from SFO back by one day. The origin, destination, and trip type will stay the same.

Please go ahead and check the available nonstop flights for the outgoing leg on the next day, and the return flights from SFO on the new date. Also, I only want flights that depart after 8am and before 9pm.

Yes, please go ahead and change my outgoing flight to HAT072 on 2024-05-19 and my return flight to HAT278 on 2024-05-23, both in economy class. 

Can you let me know if there are any fees for making these changes?

Thank you for confirming the changes and honoring the insurance policy!

Actually, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class for both legs and add 2 checked bags. Can you let me know how much that would cost? I’m willing to pay up to $200 for the upgrade and bags. If it’s more than that, I’m okay with keeping economy for the return flight, but I still want to add the 2 checked bags.

Let’s go ahead and upgrade only the outgoing flight to business class and keep the return flight in economy. Please also add the 2 checked bags. I’m fine with paying the $152 for the upgrade, and I’d like to use my original form of payment. Thank you!
Yes, that’s all correct—please proceed with those changes. Thank you!
Let’s use the other gift card with the $200 balance to cover the $152 upgrade cost. Please go ahead and process the upgrade and add the 2 checked bags. Thanks for your help!
Yes, that’s perfect—please proceed with those changes. Thank you so much for your assistance! ###STOP###
